checks: Strict owner/customer scope, including exact null versus number; staff/invalid-customer wrapper returns before mount or API calls.

Runtime catalog and batch validators bind resource IDs, original request UUID and kind, owner scope, selected connection, preview hash and exact selected customer/location pairs. Physical location aliases cannot share one batch.
Candidate Google identities must match the authoritative catalog title/address/resource/observed time; ready catalog row count must match locations and nonready catalogs expose no locations.
Read-only context/catalog allow empty CRM names as problem rows; cards show missing-name placeholder+ID and cannot select. Frozen batch validation still requires nonempty names.
Identity-keyed component remount, alive/identity/sequence guards, AbortController cleanup and monotonic revisions prevent prior actor/customer/connection results from populating a new scope.
Changing connections clears old catalog, preview, choices and consent, invalidates callbacks, and is disabled for active or unknown work.

Mutations synchronously hold busyRef against duplicate clicks; uncertain results retain the original opaque UUID. Polling and reload recovery only use GET. Same-body replay requires original body still in memory, explicit 404 query and explicit owner checkbox.

Session storage holds only owner+scope-keyed opaque UUID/kind/resource pointers, not names, addresses or frozen pairs. Explicit local exit parks the UUID without canceling, retrying or claiming the server failed.
Cancel uses the latest current revision of the same frozen batch. Progress preserves stop intent; resource or preview-hash changes reset consent. Late responses cannot restore an older revision.
New onboarding UI calls only discovery/preview/confirm/cancel and reads; no grants, customer edits, public posting, scheduling or private-space entry is introduced.

Model metadata registration does not generate generic CRUD routes. main.py discovers only explicit APIRouters; unknown api paths fail 404/405. No generic entities table-name wildcard or new model alias is registered.
limitations: Read review and isolated ASGI generic-route probe only; production deployment and authenticated acceptance remain root responsibilities.

resolved_findings.issue: Empty CRM names initially rejected the entire read-only context/catalog instead of being isolated problem rows.
resolved_findings.resolution: Fixed in V2: tolerate missing read-only names, label them and exclude selection; require names for batch rows.

resolved_findings.issue: Ready catalog count could disagree with actual location rows.
resolved_findings.resolution: V2 validates exact ready count and empty nonready result rows.
